title: Off-Cycle Dispensing Adjustment — Claims Review Rule
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit, lost or stolen supplies.** Recent dispensing outside the ordinary refill cycle on a member's pharmacy coverage shortens a lost or stolen replacement.

**Rule.** The off-cycle adjustment counts the emergency supplies, transition fills and vacation fills dispensed on the coverage in the last month: minus four days for three (3) or more, minus two days for one or two, and nothing for none.

The dispensings counted are, on the member's pharmacy claims with a fill date in the last month, every emergency supply, every paid transition fill and every paid fill marked as a vacation override fill, of any drug. The adjustment is added to the replacement base days, and the replacement days are never fewer than one day after it.

### Table

| Emergency supplies, transition fills and vacation fills in the last month | Off-cycle adjustment |
|---|---|
| Three or more | Minus 4 days (a signed adjustment of -4) |
| One or two | Minus 2 days (a signed adjustment of -2) |
| None | Nothing |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- One emergency supply and one transition fill in the last month: two, minus 2 days.
- One emergency supply, one transition fill and one vacation fill in the last month: three, minus 4 days.
- A vacation fill five weeks ago and nothing since: outside the month, nothing.
